notes: Read all three units, global civil-society context, all eleven candidates and the review. Normalized the independent-media metaphor into its asserted democratic role, named the U.S. visa jurisdiction and outside-U.S. organizing scope, preserved the causal assertion about labor standards with appropriate factual and evaluative types, and restored the source's explicit condemnation of poverty-wage, child and slave labor.

claims.claim_text: Independent media is characterized as protecting democracy rather than opposing the public.
Democrats would increase U.S. visas for trafficking victims while mass migration affects many vulnerable communities.
Democrats assert that improving global labor standards protects human rights and promotes broad-based prosperity.
Democrats characterize poverty-wage, child and slave labor as evils they would fight to end.
Democrats would support organizing rights for unions and workers outside the United States, including ILO conventions on association and collective bargaining.
